title: Point-in-time quote matching without future leakage
category: rolling/non-equi joins, tie-breaking, instants vs time zones, scale
substitution: The specification's H04 targets data.table. data.table is not installed in the pinned executor or scorer images (inspected 2026-10-24) and must not be installed during trials, so this task keeps the same as-of semantics with the installed, documented dplyr 1.2.1 join_by()/closest() rolling-join API (any installed approach is accepted).
source: Original task from R_Knowledge_MCP_Hard_Benchmark_v1.md (H04), adapted as described in `substitution`. No third-party prompt, solution or verifier is reproduced.
difficulty_hypothesis: Common errors: strict inequality excluding equal-time quotes, missing staleness bound or wrong boundary, ties by row order instead of quote_seq, nearest-in-absolute-time matching (future leakage), merge()/distinct() reordering or collapsing duplicate trades, filtering NA prices after matching, zero-row type loss, and O(trades x quotes) scans that miss the 100k/30s bound.
expected_mcp_relevance: High for API discovery: dplyr::join_by(), closest(), the multiple/relationship arguments and their tie semantics are documented in dplyr Rd available through get_function_docs; without documentation agents often fall back to slow manual scans.
setup_prerequisites: Scorer and executor images contain R 4.5.2 with dplyr, tibble, callr and testthat matching configs/renv.lock; no network or package installation.
